`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module arbiter #
(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)
(
    input  wire                     clk,
    input  wire                     rst,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         request,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0]         grant,
    output wire                     grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg = 0, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg = 0, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg = 0, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg = 0, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
wire masked_request_valid;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request;

assign masked_request = request & mask_reg;

// Retain the frozen encoders for the binary index and valid outputs.
// Their binary-to-one-hot outputs are deliberately unused.
priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
)
priority_encoder_inst (
    .input_unencoded(request),
    .output_valid(request_valid),
    .output_encoded(request_index),
    .output_unencoded()
);

priority_encoder #(
    .WIDTH(PORTS),
    .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
)
priority_encoder_masked (
    .input_unencoded(masked_request),
    .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
    .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
    .output_unencoded()
);

// Inclusive priority-direction OR prefixes.  Constant shifts form a
// logarithmic-depth network, not a variable shifter.
localparam PREFIX_LEVELS = $clog2(PORTS);
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_prefix [PREFIX_LEVELS:0];
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_prefix [PREFIX_LEVELS:0];

assign request_prefix[0] = request;
assign masked_prefix[0] = masked_request;

generate
    genvar level;
    for (level = 0; level < PREFIX_LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_levels
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_first
            assign request_prefix[level+1] = request_prefix[level]
                | (request_prefix[level] << (2**level));
            assign masked_prefix[level+1] = masked_prefix[level]
                | (masked_prefix[level] << (2**level));
        end else begin : msb_first
            assign request_prefix[level+1] = request_prefix[level]
                | (request_prefix[level] >> (2**level));
            assign masked_prefix[level+1] = masked_prefix[level]
                | (masked_prefix[level] >> (2**level));
        end
    end
endgenerate

wire [PORTS-1:0] request_follow_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_follow_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_onehot;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_onehot;

generate
    if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_masks
        assign request_follow_mask = request_prefix[PREFIX_LEVELS] << 1;
        assign masked_follow_mask = masked_prefix[PREFIX_LEVELS] << 1;
    end else begin : msb_masks
        assign request_follow_mask = request_prefix[PREFIX_LEVELS] >> 1;
        assign masked_follow_mask = masked_prefix[PREFIX_LEVELS] >> 1;
    end
endgenerate

// A bit wins exactly when it requests and no higher-priority bit requests.
// The strict prefix also equals the next round-robin eligibility mask.
assign request_onehot = request & ~request_follow_mask;
assign masked_onehot = masked_request & ~masked_follow_mask;

wire use_masked;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_grant;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] selected_index;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_follow_mask;

assign use_masked = ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && masked_request_valid;
assign selected_grant = use_masked ? masked_onehot : request_onehot;
assign selected_index = use_masked ? masked_request_index : request_index;
assign selected_follow_mask = use_masked ? masked_follow_mask : request_follow_mask;

always @* begin
    grant_next = 0;
    grant_valid_next = 0;
    grant_encoded_next = 0;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (grant_reg & request)) begin
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(grant_reg & acknowledge)) begin
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (request_valid) begin
        grant_valid_next = 1;
        grant_next = selected_grant;
        grant_encoded_next = selected_index;
        if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
            mask_next = selected_follow_mask;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    grant_reg <= grant_next;
    grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
    grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
    mask_reg <= mask_next;

    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original round-robin feedback path can traverse request masking, priority encoding, index arithmetic and variable shifting before reaching mask_reg. Its one-hot grant path also decodes the encoded winner. These are structural timing risks; no timing report was supplied to establish the actual critical path.",
  "rewrite": "Keep the frozen priority_encoder instances for valid and binary index generation. Compute one-hot winners and next round-robin masks directly with parallel priority-direction OR prefixes. For MSB-first arbitration, each strict-prefix bit indicates whether any higher-numbered request exists; for LSB-first arbitration it indicates whether any lower-numbered request exists. This strict prefix is exactly the mask following the winning request, and request AND NOT strict-prefix is exactly its one-hot grant. Preserve the original blocking, hold, idle and synchronous reset decisions.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Unmeasured. For PORTS=32, each prefix network has five constant-shift OR stages. The rewrite removes binary-index arithmetic and variable shifting from mask generation, and binary-to-one-hot decoding from grant generation. It is expected to shorten those feedback paths, but setup WNS improvement must be established by EDA at the fixed settings.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix networks add combinational logic alongside the retained binary encoders, while removing their used one-hot decoders and the variable mask shifters. No registers or pipeline stages are added. Net mapped area, routing cost and compliance with the 4880.43072 um2 cap remain unmeasured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves top name, parameter names/defaults, native port widths and signedness, existing register initialization semantics, single positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high reset, and output latency. Blocking and mask-update conditions remain unchanged, including resets after startup. Prefix identities support arbitrary simultaneous request bits and do not assume one-hot requests or acknowledges. The frozen dependency is instantiated, not redefined. No additional startup assumptions are introduced. Formal equivalence against the original frozen RTL and timing/area validation are still required."
}
